entities.summary: Georghios Pikis was a Cypriot judge who was a member of the International Criminal Court. He was President of the Supreme Court of Cyprus from 1995 to 2004, and he also served as an ad hoc judge of the European Court of Human Rights and as a member of the United Nations Committee against Torture.
